CALYREX_STRIKE.title: Strike
CALYREX_DEFEND.title: Defend
MOUNT.title: Mount
MOUNT.description: [orange]Mount[/orange]. Choose one of your steeds to merge with Calyrex: gain 1 [green]Eternal Whinny[/green] and assume the mounted form. Play again to switch or unmount.
CALYREX_FEED.title: Feed
MOUNT_CHOICE_GLASTRIER.title: Glastrier
MOUNT_CHOICE_GLASTRIER.description: Merge with Calyrex and assume the mounted form.
MOUNT_CHOICE_SPECTRIER.title: Spectrier
MOUNT_CHOICE_SPECTRIER.description: Merge with Calyrex and assume the mounted form.
KEYWORD_MOUNT.title: Mount
KEYWORD_MOUNT.description: Select one of your steeds to merge with Calyrex: gain 1 Eternal Whinny and assume the mounted form. While mounted, play Mount again to switch steeds or unmount (the steed returns). The unmounted steed keeps shielding Calyrex from damage.
KEYWORD_FEED.title: Feed
KEYWORD_FEED.description: Feed X: Both of your steeds gain X max HP.
MOUNT_CHOICE_UNMOUNT.title: Unmount
MOUNT_CHOICE_UNMOUNT.description: Unmerge your steed from Calyrex. The steed returns.
FEED.description: [orange]Feed[/orange] {Amount:diff()}. Your steeds gain {Amount} max HP (they start combat at 0 HP).
DIVINE_BLESSING.title: Divine Blessing
BERRY_GUST.title: Berry Gust
HARVEST.title: Harvest
HARVEST.description: Consume {Percent:diff()}% of your [green]Abundance[/green]. Deal {PerLayer:diff()} damage per layer consumed.
ROYAL_GLEAM.title: Royal Gleam
BONDED_REINS.title: Bonded Reins
ASTRAL_BARRAGE.title: Astral Barrage
ASTRAL_BARRAGE.description: [orange]X[/orange]. Deal X+{Hits:diff()} hits of X damage to ALL enemies and apply 1 [green]Weak[/green] to each. Usable only while riding Spectrier.
GLACIAL_LANCE.title: Glacial Lance
GLACIAL_LANCE.description: [orange]Ride Glastrier[/orange]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies twice, applying 2 [blue]Frozen[/blue] each. (Upgraded: 5 damage 3 times, 3 Frozen)
SPIKY_DEFENSE.title: Spiky Defense
GRASS_KNOT.title: Grass Knot
GRASS_KNOT.description: Deal damage equal to 25% of target's max HP (cap {Cap:diff()}), gain [green]Abundance[/green] equal to it.
PROTECT.title: Protect
PROTECT.description: Usable only if you haven't played a card this turn. Gain 999 [gold]Block[/gold]. End your turn. [orange]Exhaust[/orange].
DYNAMAX_FORM.title: Dynamax Form
DYNAMAX_FORM.description: Until the end of next turn, all damage you deal is tripled.
BATON_PASS.title: Baton Pass
BATON_PASS.description: Retain your [gold]Block[/gold] and temporary effects for one turn.
HELPING_HAND.title: Helping Hand
STRENGTH_SAP.title: Strength Sap
STRENGTH_SAP.description: Heal for {Percent:diff()}% of the damage the target is about to deal. Reduce its Strength by {StrengthLoss}. [orange]Exhaust[/orange].
SOUL_BLAST.title: Soul-Stealing Rhythmic Blast
SOUL_BLAST.description: Lose {HpCost:diff()} HP. Gain 5 Energy. Draw until your hand is full. [orange]Exhaust[/orange].
BOOMBURST.title: Boomburst
BOOMBURST.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies and both steeds, then take reduced damage yourself. (Upgraded: lose 7 HP)
QUICK_ATTACK.title: Quick Attack
GRASSY_TERRAIN.title: Grassy Terrain
GRASSY_TERRAIN.description: At the start of each turn: Feed 3 and gain 3 [green]Abundance[/green]. (Upgraded: {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)})
GRASSY_GLIDE.title: Grassy Glide
GRASSY_GLIDE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Deal an additional {PerAbundance:diff()} damage for each [green]Abundance[/green].
HEROIC_SACRIFICE.title: Heroic Sacrifice
HEROIC_SACRIFICE.description: Sacrifice a live steed: gain 1 [green]Abundance[/green] for every 2 HP lost. (Upgraded: {energyPrefix:energyIcons(0)})
TRIBUTE.title: Tribute
TRIBUTE.description: Lose all [green]Abundance[/green]. Feed {FeedPer:diff()} to your steeds for each lost.
GALLOP.title: Gallop
GALLOP.description: Choose a steed; the other loses 3 HP. Gain 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
SUBSTITUTE.title: Substitute
SUBSTITUTE.description: Take 5 unblockable damage, gain 1 [gold]Buffer[/gold]. Exhaust. (Upgraded: take 6)
HIGH_HORSEPOWER.title: High Horsepower
HIGH_HORSEPOWER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Double it if the target has [gold]Block[/gold].
TRUCE.title: Truce
TRUCE.description: Double your [green]Abundance[/green] and gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the doubled amount. You cannot play Attack cards this turn. (Upgraded: gain 3 Abundance first.)
TERA_BLAST.title: Tera Blast
CLEAN_UP_FIRST.title: I'll Clean Up First!
ROYAL_FAVOR.title: Royal Favor
ROYAL_FAVOR.description: Immediately trigger [green]Abundance[/green]: heal HP equal to its stacks. [orange]Exhaust[/orange].
DARK_GLEAM.title: Dark Gleam
DARK_GLEAM.description: Shuffle an [orange]Astral Barrage[/orange] into your draw pile, upgrade all Astral Barrages, and add all Astral Barrages to your hand.
PALE_LANCE.title: Pale Lance
PALE_LANCE.description: Shuffle a [orange]Glacial Lance[/orange] into your draw pile, upgrade all Glacial Lances, and add all Glacial Lances to your hand.
STORED_POWER.title: Stored Power
STORED_POWER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, +2 damage per stack of [green]Strength[/green], [gold]Dexterity[/gold] or [green]Abundance[/green]. (Upgraded: +3)
RECALL.title: Recall
RECALL.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Choose a card in your exhaust pile and add a copy of it to your hand.
FUTURE_SIGHT.title: Future Sight
FUTURE_SIGHT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to an enemy in 2 turns.
PSYCHIC.title: Psychic
UPROAR_ROAR.title: Uproar
PLANT_CARROT.title: Plant Carrot
PLANT_CARROT.description: Gain {Abundance:diff()} [green]Abundance[/green], [orange]Feed[/orange] {Feed:diff()}, and give a steed +1 Quick Sight or Heavy Lance.
ACCELERATE.title: Accelerate!!
ACCELERATE.description: [orange]Ride Spectrier[/orange]. Every {energyPrefix:energyIcons(3)} spent, gain 1 energy and 1 [green]Strength[/green].
SLOW_DOWN.title: Slow Down!!
SLOW_DOWN.description: [orange]Ride Glastrier[/orange]. Apply 5 [blue]Frozen[/blue] to all enemies. Every {energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)} spent, add a copy of the last card played (0-cost, Exhaust) to hand.
EXTREME_SPEED.title: Extreme Speed
EXTREME_SPEED.description: [orange]Mount Spectrier[/orange]. Gain 1 Energy for each card in your exhaust pile. [orange]Exhaust[/orange].
DEFEND_POSITION.title: Defend Position
DEFEND_POSITION.description: [orange]Mount Glastrier[/orange]. Gain {PerCard:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each card in your hand. [orange]Exhaust[/orange].
ZEN_HEADBUTT.title: Zen Headbutt
ZEN_HEADBUTT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. {StunChance:diff()}% chance to stun the target.
ANXIOUS.title: Anxious
ANXIOUS.description: Take 4 unblockable damage, then Mount. (Upgraded: take 2)
LONE_PATH.title: Lone Path
LONE_PATH.description: Unmount. You cannot mount again this combat. Gain {Abundance:diff()} [green]Abundance[/green].
SEED_BOMB.title: Seed Bomb
PARTING_SHOT.title: Parting Shot
CATASTROPHIC_BLOW.title: Catastrophe
CATASTROPHIC_BLOW.description: An enemy loses half its HP (30 against bosses). [orange]Exhaust[/orange].
FAKE_OUT.title: Fake Out
FAKE_OUT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If this is the first card played this turn, stun the target. [orange]Exhaust[/orange].
PHANTOM_FORCE.title: Phantom Force
FROST.title: Frost
FROST.description: Gain {PerFrost:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each [blue]Frozen[/blue] stack on the field.
CROWN_TUNDRA.title: Crown Tundra
CROWN_TUNDRA.description: Apply [blue]Frozen[/blue] to all enemies equal to your [green]Abundance[/green]. Exhaust. (Upgraded: Retain, cost unchanged)
LEECH_SEED.title: Leech Seed
LEECH_SEED.description: Target an enemy: it loses 8 HP at the end of each turn, and you heal 4 HP.
HORSE_LOVE.title: Horse Love
ALL_OUT_ATTACK.title: All-Out Attack
ALL_OUT_ATTACK.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus the other steed's current HP as damage. [orange]Mounted[/orange].
INTENSIVE_PLANTING.title: Intensive Planting
INTIMIDATE.title: Intimidate
PRESSURE.title: Pressure
PRESSURE.description: Whenever an enemy attacks, it gains 1 [green]Vulnerable[/green].
MALEFIC_CURSE.title: Malefic Curse
MALEFIC_CURSE.description: Lose half your HP. Apply [green]Doom[/green] equal to your [green]Abundance[/green] to an enemy. [orange]Exhaust[/orange].
ICY_WIND.title: Icy Wind
INGRAIN.title: Ingrain
INGRAIN.description: Whenever you [orange]Feed[/orange] or gain [green]Abundance[/green], draw a card.
SOUL_HEART.title: Soul Heart
SOUL_HEART.description: Whenever a unit dies (incl. steeds), draw 2 cards and gain 1 energy. (Upgraded: {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)})
TRICK.title: Trick
TRICK.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Lose 1 [green]Strength[/green] and 1 [green]Dexterity[/green] this turn.
GLACIAL_WORLD.title: Glacial World
ABSOLUTE_ZERO.title: Absolute Zero
ABSOLUTE_ZERO.description: Kill all enemies with {Threshold:diff()} or more [blue]Frozen[/blue].
WISH_GRANT.title: Wish
WISH_GRANT.description: Cannot be played the turn it is drawn. Can be played if retained last turn. Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy. [orange]Retain[/orange].
SHADOW_BALL.title: Shadow Ball
P_P_RESTORE_CARD.title: PP Restore
P_P_RESTORE_CARD.description: The first time you play an X-cost card each turn, gain 4 energy.
WIDE_GUARD.title: Wide Guard
LONG_HOWL.title: Long Howl
FRIENDLY_GUARD.title: Friendly Guard
COURAGE_ROPE.title: Courage Rope
COURAGE_ROPE.description: [gold]Stun[/gold] an enemy. Feed 4 and Mount. Exhaust. (Upgraded: Innate+Retain, Feed 6)
ENCORE.title: Encore
ENCORE.description: Lock an enemy's action this turn: for the next 3 turns, it repeats that action at the end of each turn (intent replaced).
ACCELERATE.handSelectionPrompt: Choose a card in hand to gain Replay 2 and Exhaust
ACCELERATE.drawSelectionPrompt: Choose a card in the draw pile to gain Replay 2 and Exhaust
ZERO.title: Zero
IRON_DEFENSE.title: Iron Defense
FLY.title: Fly
FLY.description: Gain {Fly:diff()} [gold]Fly[/gold]: attack damage taken is halved.
POLLEN_PUFF.title: Pollen Puff
POLLEN_PUFF.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to an enemy; heal a steed for 33% of its max HP.
DEFIANT.title: Defiant
DEFIANT.description: Whenever a debuff is applied to you, gain 1 [green]Strength[/green].
DRACO_METEOR.title: Draco Meteor
DRACO_METEOR.description: Deal {Hits:diff()} x {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies, lose 2 [green]Strength[/green].
LAST_RESORT.title: Last Resort
LAST_RESORT.description: Your energy does not reset each turn.
SAND_ATTACK.title: Sand Attack
ECHOING_WHINNY.title: Echoing Whinny
ECHOING_WHINNY.description: Add [gold]Replay 2[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] to a card in hand and a card in the draw pile.
ECHOING_WHINNY.handSelectionPrompt: Choose a card in hand to gain Replay 2 and Exhaust
ECHOING_WHINNY.drawSelectionPrompt: Choose a card in the draw pile to gain Replay 2 and Exhaust
Z_CELEBRATE.title: Z-Celebrate
PSYCH_UP.title: Psych Up
PSYCH_UP.description: Copy a positive effect from a creature.
SPOTLIGHT.title: Spotlight
SPOTLIGHT.description: This enemy takes +50% damage from [gold]AOE[/gold] attacks.
MOVE_RECORD.title: Move Record
MOVE_RECORD.description: Choose 1 of 4 random Exhaust cards to add to your hand; it costs 0 this turn.
ICICLE_CRASH.title: Icicle Crash
ICICLE_CRASH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, +{PerFrost:diff()} per [blue]Frozen[/blue] on the target.
TRIPLE_AXEL.title: Triple Axel
PSYCHIC_NOISE.title: Psychic Noise
PSYCHIC_NOISE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage; the target's next {Blocks:diff()} heals are negated.
CALYREX_HAZE.title: Haze
CALYREX_HAZE.description: Transform any number of cards in your hand into [gold]Zero[/gold].
CALYREX_HAZE.selectionPrompt: Choose cards to transform into Zero
CALYREX_POUNCE.title: Pounce
CALYREX_POUNCE.description: Deal damage equal to your current [gold]Block[/gold].
